title: Set 1: 10 Entrepreneurial Mindset Characteristics
description: Match each characteristic with its proper definition or description based on the module.

pairs.right: Intellectual process of actively analyzing, assessing, and evaluating information
pairs.explanation: Disciplined thinking to make rational and informed decisions.

pairs.right: Capacity to adjust quickly to rapid changes in technology and markets
pairs.explanation: Remaining receptive to new conditions to stay relevant.

pairs.right: Identifying problems and unmet customer needs as business opportunities
pairs.explanation: The ability to spot viable business solutions within everyday consumer challenges.

pairs.right: Bouncing back swiftly from failures and using them as learning experiences
pairs.explanation: Maintaining positive momentum after encountering setbacks or errors.

pairs.right: Maximizing limited resources and discovering innovative alternatives
pairs.explanation: Finding effective workarounds despite budgetary or physical constraints.

title: Set 2: Three Forms of Business Structures
description: Match each business structure with its key feature, advantage, or liability model.

pairs.right: Owned by one individual; total control but bears Unlimited Liability
pairs.explanation: Simple to launch via DTI, but personal property is vulnerable to business debts.

pairs.right: Owned by 2+ individuals; pooled capital and skills but has Limited Life
pairs.explanation: Dissolves upon the withdrawal, bankruptcy, or death of a partner.

pairs.right: Separate legal entity; features Limited Liability and Perpetual Existence
pairs.explanation: Owned by shareholders and legally registered through the SEC.

pairs.right: Partners personally subject to unlimited liability for business debts
pairs.explanation: Actively manage the firm and answer for partnership obligations.

pairs.right: Owners whose financial liability is limited to the value of their shareholdings
pairs.explanation: Personal assets remain insulated from corporate insolvency.

title: Set 3: Registration Agencies and Documents
description: Match each government agency or permit with its primary purpose in business registration.

pairs.right: Business Name registration for Sole Proprietorships
pairs.explanation: Issues the DTI Business Name Certificate.

pairs.right: Registration and regulation of Partnerships and Corporations
pairs.explanation: Certifies the legal personality of corporate and partnership entities.

pairs.right: Issuance of TIN, registration of books of accounts, and official receipts
pairs.explanation: National tax authority overseeing tax compliance and Form 2303.

pairs.right: Initial local community permit required before applying for a Mayor's Permit
pairs.explanation: Secured from the local barangay where the enterprise is situated.

pairs.right: Final operational license issued by the City or Municipal Hall
pairs.explanation: Granted by the BPLO upon completing fire, sanitary, and barangay clearances.
